from z3 import *
dice = [[Int(f'd{i}_{j}') for j in range(6)] for i in range(5)]
s = Solver()
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(6):
        s.add(dice[i][j] >= 0, dice[i][j] <= 11)
for k in range(5):
    A = dice[k]
    B = dice[(k+1)%5]
    wins = Sum([If(A[i] > B[j], 1, 0) for i in range(6) for j in range(6)])
    s.add(wins >= 19)
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(5):
        s.add(dice[i][j] <= dice[i][j+1])
s.add(Or([dice[0][j] != 5 for j in range(6)]))
s.check()
m = s.model()
flat = []
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(6):
        val = m.evaluate(dice[i][j]).as_long()
        flat.append(val)
print(flat)
for ii in range(5):
    A = flat[ii*6:(ii+1)*6]
    B = flat[((ii+1)%5)*6:((ii+2)%5)*6]
